label: Midday Update
headline: S&P 500 +5.0% at 11:33, Brent -6.6%, VIX 27.4, 10y 4.94%
stance: Stocks rebounded hard on news before the open; the S&P 500 is up 5% after seven straight losses. Oil fell on returning supply; Treasuries barely moved.

scorecard.actual: Rally more than doubled: Nasdaq +7% at 11:13 (CNBC). Biggest Nasdaq opening gain since at least 1991.

scorecard.call: Treasuries are working as an equity hedge into the Dec 9 FOMC.
scorecard.actual: Untested today: 10y 4.94% at 11:18, +1.6bp, while stocks rose 5%.

scorecard.call: Libya output down; Houthis claim a strike on a Saudi refinery.
scorecard.actual: Brent fell anyway: $86.51 at 11:23, -6.6% on returning supply.

bullets: S&P 500 7,256 at 11:33, +5.0% vs Friday. VIX 27.4, down from 35.9 at Friday's close.
US services flash purchasing managers index 54.7 vs 55.7 expected (~9:45am ET). Manufacturing 54.5 vs 54.9.
Brent $86.51 at 11:23, -6.6%. West Texas crude at its lowest since late August (~10:51am ET).
MOVE bond volatility index 104.0 at 11:18, down 2.3 points.

items.head: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
items.body: Board says it had input from senior US officials (~8:56am ET). Stock +33% (~11:17am ET).

items.head: CoreWeave +24% in AI-linked rally
items.body: Oracle also higher on the Nvidia news (~10:03am ET, ~11:27am ET).

items.head: UnitedHealth, Humana, CVS fall
items.body: US government targets Medicare Advantage star ratings (~9:39am ET).

watch.head: PCE, GDP, claims, durables, Wed 8:30
watch.body: All four land Wednesday morning. US markets close Thursday for Thanksgiving.

watch.head: Iran
watch.body: Trump told Fox News strikes on Iran could resume after New Year without a deal (~7:30am ET).
